result.title: What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting
result.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. The first three authors contributed equally to this work. Supplementary material is not included in this version
result.summary: Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RecastAgent，在冻结权重下用经验引导的 agent 框架做源条件视频重铸：规划器依据视觉批判选择编辑提示与输入视频状态，可基于部分进展继续或回溯以保留原事件结构，并把完成的轨迹蒸馏为带证据链接的条件性原则，另构建 67 个源视频、134 个配对任务的基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「轨迹→有条件成立范围的证据化经验」积累与回溯/继续的决策机制，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、贡献分配及停止决策提供线索，但任务本身是视频编辑，经验能否迁移到 latent 推理状态更新尚待核查。
